message: On an iPad held sideways or a Mac, Today now lays its categories out in columns across the window, and a task opens in a pane on the right only while you edit it. Drag a task to any column to move it. Prefer one list? Settings, Appearance, Wide windows has a List layout that shows the rest of your day beside it, with one-line rows on a Mac. The sidebar can also fold to just icons (the button at its foot, or Control-Command-S).
